root_cause: Upstream `orders` column renamed from `customer_id` to `cust_id` but `stg_orders` still selects `customer_id`, causing binder/compilation error.
evidence: Binder Error: customer_id not found in FROM clause
Candidate bindings are cust_id, order_id, order_date, amount
Upstream orders has cust_id not customer_id
patch:
--- a/models/staging/stg_orders.sql
+++ b/models/staging/stg_orders.sql
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 select
     order_id,
-    customer_id,
+    cust_id as customer_id,
     cast(order_date as date) as order_date,
     amount,
     status
 from {{ ref('orders') }}
